releases.body:
> `loopd_command_*` now covers everything `opencode-pty` (`pty_spawn/write/read/list/kill`) and `opencode-sentinel` (`sentinel_monitor/stop/list`) do — remove both plugins from config. Live-smoked on the real PTY backend (timeout, until-stop, pattern read, env, terminate+remove).

### Fixed

- **V2 dashboard `o` opens the command terminal** — the mounted dashboard had no terminal opener and its key/event path returned early whenever the dialog was not open, so selecting a command in the Commands tab (or the session panel entrypoint) did nothing. The dashboard now receives the terminal opener and no longer suppresses command events; covered by mounted v2 tests for the command list, panel entrypoint, and the registered route, including `Ctrl+]` detaching without terminating the command.
- **v2 native `write` rejected inside a valid scope claim** — `structuredWritePaths` only read `args.filePath`, but the v2 native write tool sends `path`. A scoped worker holding a valid claim was denied with `Scope denied: write requires filePath`, so `write_scope` goals could not write their own files on v2. Both field names are now accepted, conflicting `filePath`/`path` values are rejected, and the regression is covered by unit tests plus the real-host smoke gate.

### Added

- **Lifecycle release gate** — `bun run smoke:v2-lifecycle` boots a disposable `opencode serve` (private `XDG_*`, private database, loopback fixture model, built `dist/server.js`) and asserts the lifecycle guarantees against a real host: plugin activation, CodeMode goal creation, separate worker, automatic continuation, checked completion rejection, native write, single owner notification, busy steering, interactive no-auto-continue, pause across a real host restart, resume, clear-during-execution, and scoped claim enforcement. The host version is pinned and verified. `npm publish` now runs it first and uploads private artifacts on failure.
- **`docs/lifecycle-contract.md`** — the guaranteed behaviors, the assertions backing each one, and an explicit not-covered list (real provider quota, interactive TUI, native child-bridge topology, power loss, lock-contention reads).
- **Unified same-goal identity switching** — `switch_goal_identity` replaces the separate model/agent owner tools and control operations. Optional `model` and `agent` fields support one-field changes or a combined transaction; at least one is required. Combined assignments persist atomically, busy pairs defer together, and successful host changes roll back on partial failure. Dashboard `:model`/`:agent` dispatch the unified operation. The existing goal, worker session, transcript, progress, checks and budgets are preserved; there is no implicit interactive wake. Explicit resume requires a blocked goal (model-only still requires a provider-limit blocker).
- **Agent model discovery and same-goal recovery** — `loopd_list_models` exposes safe provider/model metadata, host capabilities, and owner-scoped goal identities; `switch_goal_identity` validates ownership/availability, defers busy workers, and preserves the existing worker session and budgets. Optional `fallbackModels` prepares ordered, one-shot alternatives only for observed provider quota/rate-limit errors; interactive goals never auto-wake. Remaining quota/reset information is **unknown/unsupported** in the inspected host APIs, never inferred from connected accounts or API keys. Covered by automated host/service/tool tests; no live provider-exhaustion or TUI proof claimed.
- **M1 pty parity** — `env` (values to host, names-only persistence), `timeout_seconds` (in-memory deadline → terminate path, `endReason=timeout`, always notifies), `shell:true` (`/bin/sh -c`), `pattern`+`ignore_case` log read (ANSI-stripped match, ReDoS guard), `terminate remove:true`, `endReason` (`exit|terminate|timeout|until|missing`) on every terminal transition.
- **M2 sentinel watcher engine** — `watch_filter`/`watch_until`/`watch_ignore_case`/`watch_until_action (stop|keep

### Fixed

- Legacy goal workers now treat a host-closed assistant turn with no finish reason or output as a failed attempt rather than successful completion. Failures enter the existing bounded retry and blocking policy, clear the active run fence, and notify the owner when blocked.
- Legacy idle reconciliation recognizes outputless closes in normalized transcripts when a live event was missed, while fencing recovery to the current run. In-flight and genuinely completed turns remain unaffected; native execution supervision retains host authority.
- The dashboard labels a provider retry as `Retrying` instead of `Unconfirmed`.
- Native v2 nudge and steering distinguish accepted inbox items from observed delivery. Undelivered receipts survive repeated nudges without duplicate prompts, and failed execution observations no longer recycle cached acceptance-time `busy` status.

### Verification

- Added outputless-turn regression coverage for live events, missed events, stale turns, native execution boundaries, retry exhaustion, and status labels.
- The fix is exercised by automated tests; a real quota-exhausted provider session has not been used to verify recovery end to end.
